creature.name: Tideglass Warden

printed.imm: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

entries: When the warden takes Thunder damage, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
The warden can breathe underwater and ignores Difficult Terrain caused by water.
The warden makes two Glass Fist attacks.
Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Slashing damage.
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the warden. Failure: 11 (2d10) Slashing damage. Success: Half damage.
Trigger: The warden is targeted by a ray or beam of light. Response: The warden redirects it at a creature within 30 feet.

creature.name: Mire Crawler
entries: A creature that starts its turn Grappled by the crawler sinks 5 feet into its body and has the Restrained condition.
The crawler makes one Slam attack and uses Engulf.
Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.
Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet. Failure: The target is Grappled (escape DC 17).
The crawler moves up to its Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

creature.name: Gloam Regent
creature.legendaryIntro: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the regent can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The regent regains all expended uses at the start of its turn.
entries: If the regent fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
Allies within 30 feet of the regent have Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.
The regent makes two Gloaming Blade attacks and uses Dim the Light.
Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the regent. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. Success: The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
The regent teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see in Dim Light or Darkness.
Trigger: The regent is hit by a melee attack roll. Response: The regent adds 3 to its AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.
The regent moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
The regent makes one Gloaming Blade attack.
The regent uses Dim the Light if it is available.
